name: Package Tracking
summary: Track packages from UPS, FedEx, USPS, and Amazon

tools.name: package_track
tools.description: Look up a package by tracking number and return the carrier and tracking URL.

carrier.description: Optional carrier override: UPS, FedEx, USPS, or Amazon

tools.name: package_add
tools.description: Save a package to the tracking list, with an optional label.

carrier.description: Optional carrier override: UPS, FedEx, USPS, or Amazon

tools.name: package_remove
tools.description: Remove a saved package from the tracking list.

tools.name: package_list
tools.description: List saved packages with carriers, tracking URLs, labels, and added dates.

tools.name: package_scan
tools.description: Scan text for package tracking numbers and identify their carriers.

text.description: Text to scan for tracking numbers (e.g., email body)
